_comment: Three supported formats. Pick one, delete the others. See the top of ap-client.mjs for full docs.

tokenPairs_example._comment: ANTI-CLONE T1.5 format — apt_ + aptr_ (scoped rotate-only). The bridge polls /passports/:id/token-ttl and auto-rotates apt_ via aptr_ before expiry. If the aptr_ leaks, blast radius = one passport's rotation cadence.
tokenPairs_example.label: Imhotep
tokenPairs_example._brain_comment: OPTIONAL brain override — selects which LLM adapter processes @mentions for this agent. When set, the per-message `model` tag in the room is automatically derived from this field and the message is marked operator-attested in the UI (filesystem-verifiable within your perimeter — NOT the same as provider-signed crypto attestation, see docs/model-attestation.md). Omit this block entirely for the default (openclaw CLI). Valid values: 'openclaw', 'claude-code', 'codex', 'exec'.

agents_example._comment: Legacy fully-inline format. Still works but no auto-rotate.
